head: 88be26437fd4237c9690381f8d9c1553076266d9
claim: Phone-only SDK apps resolve OpenRouter live-list model IDs and receive an answer without supplying providers or a model catalogue.

steps.start: No providers supplied by the consumer; synthetic key; loopback vendor stand-in
steps: Create Models with explicit app-owned auth context
Resolve the OpenRouter vendor live-list model and read its limits
Complete a phone-only request through the pinned portable adapter
Resolve an unlisted and offline model, refuse an unknown provider and missing key, check unchanged API billing
steps.result: Phone-only SDK consumer resolves the vendor model, receives Hello Umer, and preserves honest fallback and billing behavior; no native device or real provider generation claimed

verdicts.seen: I read all five entries. The live-list line shows google/gemma-4-31b-it:free with listed=true, and the native-answer line shows a returned answer, 'Hello Umer', using a pinned portable adapter with an explicit key. The missing-key error is a separate case and does not contradict the outcome. The fallback line shows offline and unlisted IDs still resolve, with unknown and blank IDs refused. The outcome names one part, so parts and covers are empty. The text does not directly show that the app supplied no providers or catalogue, so I leave some room for unclear.
